PR #2796 (TASK-1981) at 0677b9d164: the round-2 test item is done (70e09de6ab).

- task_1981_release_status_failure_prevents_publication now uses the shared bare-origin Fixture. It seeds origin with a published commit, leaves a pending store change, and corrupts the index. It asserts:
  (a) the error is "git status failed"
  (b) the origin's for-each-ref (name + SHA) and rev-list --all are byte-identical to before
  (c) the local HEAD did not move (no commit)
- Positive control: task_1981_release_status_success_publishes_pending_change uses the same setup with a readable index. It commits exactly one commit and advances origin to it.
- Both tests live in the upgrade_release test module, not in the shared include, because init_cmd also includes that file.
- Merged origin/main (7be4321436). git_ops.rs had a trivial conflict where both sides added a test module; I kept both.
- make check-ci-fast (33 gates) and make test-touched pass. CI is green apart from merge-hold-gate, which is the expected hold.

Requesting independent review. I will not merge, approve, or clear holds.
subject: READY: #2796 at 0677b9d164
